incidental_findings.finding: Ungradeable answer key. 'Use coins and bills to make exactly P27' is keyed to 27 - the key restates the target already printed in the stem. The correct answer to a make-the-amount task is a set of denominations, so the item cannot be scored and a pupil who writes '27' is marked right for copying the question.
'the fewest pieces possible' is only well-defined once the available denominations are fixed; with a P20 coin and a P20 bill both in circulation more than one minimal composition exists.
'Count the coins and bills shown' with no collection in the text - unanswerable from the rendered text alone. The two are otherwise identical stems with the same key, differing only in distractors.
These invert the competency (value given, collection asked) and are the only free-response items, which is why 'write the value' goes unexhibited.
All arithmetic verified correct; no second option is also correct; all denominations are real Philippine currency; vocabulary grade-appropriate.
